thread:
aj: Deploybot started staged rollout for runtime-engine v2.14.0-quant-kernel. Change window tonight 22:00-02:00 UTC. Canary slice 1% across us-west and eu-west. Need telemetry + smoke owners.

lina: ack. i'll watch p95, error-rate, and kv-cache miss. stepping through canary dashboards.

marco: ack. i'll run the quick smoke on staging and run the fw-compat check.

deploybot: [deploybot] rollout created: runtime-engine@v2.14.0-quant-kernel -> canary 1% (us-west, eu-west). CI: green.

aj: rules for rollback: immediate rollback if error-rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency jump >30ms over baseline OR kv-cache-miss spike >2x. If subtle regressions, pin traffic and escalate.

sophia: noted. adding an alert for kv-cache-miss ratio >1.8x and will watch eval prompts for sampling.

marco: quick smoke logs: ```
smoke: ok
latency p50 11ms p95 38ms
kv_cache_hits 9823 kv_cache_misses 120
```

lina: canary dashboard shows small p95 drift in eu-west at minute 12 -> +18ms, error rate flat. continuing watch.

oncall-bot: [alert] eu-west: p95 latency crossed +25ms threshold at t+14m.

aj: thanks. that is close to our 30ms cut. keep monitoring 5 more minutes. if error-rate climbs start rollback.

marco: i'm going to pin older runtime on a subset of pods in eu-west: `deploybot pin runtime-engine v2.13.9 --region eu-west --pods 3` to limit blast radius.

deploybot: command accepted: pin runtime-engine v2.13.9 on 3 pods in eu-west. Will not affect canary slice.

lina: after pin, p95 in eu-west stabilized: +6ms delta now. error-rate still nominal. seems like a node-level outlier.

aj: good. we should still prepare rollback playbook in case metrics worsen. Drafting rollback steps: 1) pause rollout 2) roll traffic back to v2.13.9 globally OR regionally 3) pin v2.13.9 4) collect traces & logs 5) open postmortem if customer impact.

sophia: adding small smoke set to alerting: sample 50 requests per minute for semantic regression checks.

ops-runner: FYI i've scheduled a midnight maintenance window to bake a hotfix build with kv-cache guardrails if we need to push fast.

marco: update for release notes: include kernel ABI change summary and quant build notes: "Changed matmul tiling -> improves throughput but may increase cold-start latency on certain CUDA driver combos." Add rollback instructions and pin commands.

aj: decision: keep canary running but pause progressive ramping. owners: lina/marco/sophia on watch for next 60m. If any threshold triggered, we do a regional rollback for eu-west and pin. No global rollback unless multiple regions hit thresholds.

lina: ack. will post a short status update in #incidents if we tip into rollback.

deploybot: [deploybot] rollout paused for progressive ramp at 1% per decision by aj. Canary continues at 1%.

oncall-bot: [note] followup: if rollback occurs, please attach `kv_cache` and `matmul` traces to the incident thread.

aj: thanks team. i'll update the release notes draft and schedule a short post-deploy sync at +4h.

sophia: taking ownership of perf regression evals. will surface any prompt-level quality diffs.

marco: closing loop: i'll collect the pinned nodes' kernel versions and file an ops ticket if we need mass pin.

lina: current status: canary stable for 30m. continuing 60m watch.

aj: good. leave this thread open for any rollback triggers. :thumbsup:
